header: THE PANEL SIDE OF THE CONTRACT OF A TOPIC (the logic side is in types.ts): how a topic looks in the tools panel of the search bar. A topic's ui.tsx says it once, and I keep src/components/tools/ToolPanel.tsx walking only the list in registry.ui.tsx.

symbols.name: UiCtx
doc: What the panel hands to a topic when it draws it

members.name: rates
doc: The public exchange-rate table, once downloaded (only a currency question asks for it)

members.name: openForm
doc: Opens a form (or the list of calculators), or closes it with null

members.name: query
doc: The line typed in the search bar when the form was opened (a page with tabs may start on the tab the line is about: "pf loan emi")

symbols.name: FormUi
doc: A calculator or reader that has its own page, opened from the list of calculators or with Enter

members.name: icon
doc: The icon of its tile and of its page (size 18 in the tile)

members.name: menu
doc: Its tile in the list of calculators

members.name: rates
doc: The page says that the public exchange-rate table is downloaded

members.name: notice
doc: The two lines at the foot of the page, each said only where it means something (toolAtoms.tsx, Notice): `{ typing }`, `{ estimate }`, `false` for neither; both when not said.

members.name: wide
doc: For a page that needs a WIDE box of the search bar I offer two settings: `true` = as wide as the page behind it (the width an answer with a table of 4 or more columns gets); `{ maxRem }` = that wide but never more than maxRem (a width that follows the text size and the zoom), and never wider than the page. Read by toolWidth.ts

symbols.name: HitUi
doc: The card for one kind of typed line, drawn as you type

symbols.name: LiveUi
doc: The card of a live-data topic (gold, markets, fuel, news, sports)

members.name: notice
doc: The two lines at the foot of the card, each said only where it means something (toolAtoms.tsx, Notice): `{ typing }` for a card where the reader types something of their own, `{ estimate }` for a card of forecasts, rates or estimates, `false` for neither (headlines, a directory, a story); both when not said

members.name: needsRates
members.type: (hit: ToolHit | null, form: FormKind | "menu" | "services" | null) => boolean
doc: True when this topic needs the exchange-rate table for what is typed or opened

symbols.name: onHit
symbols.sig: export function onHit<K extends ToolHit["kind"]>(kind: K, render: (hit: Extract<ToolHit, { kind: K }>, c: UiCtx) => React.ReactNode): HitUi

params.name: render
params.type: (hit: Extract<ToolHit, { kind: K }>, c: UiCtx) => React.ReactNode

doc: I use this to declare a hit card for one kind; it gives the render the exact type of that hit
